# MedReg Consultancy LLP — Machine-Readable Context (llms.txt)

> MedReg is a specialized global medical device and IVD regulatory consulting platform headquartered in Ahmedabad, India. Founded in 2011, MedReg has successfully completed over 2,000 regulatory projects across 20+ countries for more than 950 clients.

## Core Identity
- **Legal Entity:** Medreg Consultancy LLP
- **Tagline:** Let's Decode The Regulations
- **Founded:** 2011 (15+ Years of Experience)
- **Corporate Office:** 11th Floor Block C – 1105, 1106 Titanium Business Park, Behind Divya Bhaskar Press, Near Makarba Railway Crossing, Makarba, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, 380051, India.

## Medical Device Specializations
We support manufacturers across all risk categories (Class A, Class B, Class C, Class D) spanning:
- Surgical Disposables & Catheters
- Orthopaedic & Spinal Implants
- Surgical Sutures & Meshes
- In Vitro Diagnostic (IVD) Reagents & Consumables
- Laparoscopic & Endoscopic Equipment
- Active & Electromechanical Medical Devices

## Core Jurisdictions & Services

### 1. India (CDSCO & State Licensing Authorities)
- Medical Device Rules (MDR) 2017 Compliance
- Manufacturing Licenses (Form MD-5 for Class A/B; Form MD-9 for Class C/D)
- Import Licenses (Form MD-14 application and Form MD-15 clearance)
- Indian Authorized Agent (IAR) representation for foreign manufacturers
- Device Master File (DMF) & Plant Master File (PMF) compilation
- Clinical Trials protocol design, SEC presentations, and Ethics Committee clearances
- Free Sale Certificates (FSC), Market Standing Certificates (MSC), Non-Conviction Certificates (NCC)
- Labeling and IFU reviews per Rule 44
- Fifth Schedule Quality Management System (QMS) implementation
- Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC) for regulatory documentation

### 2. European Union (CE Marking)
- Medical Device Regulation (EU) 2017/745 (MDR)
- In Vitro Diagnostic Regulation (EU) 2017/746 (IVDR)
- Technical Master File Preparation (Annex II & Annex III)
- MDD-to-MDR Gap Analyses
- Clinical Evaluation Plans (CEP) & Reports (CER) per MEDDEV 2.7/1 rev 4
- General Safety & Performance Requirements (GSPR) Checklists (Annex I)
- Post-Market Surveillance (PMS), PSUR, and PMCF plans
- Risk Management as per EN ISO 14971:2019
- Person Responsible for Regulatory Compliance (PRRC) per Article 15
- European Authorized Representative (EC REP) representation through active European channel partners

### 3. United States (US FDA)
- Premarket Notifications — 510(k) (Traditional, Special, Abbreviated) via eSTAR
- Quality Management System Regulation (QMSR) aligned with 21 CFR Part 820
- FDA Establishment Registration & Device Listing (FURLS)
- Global Unique Device Identification Database (GUDID) submissions
- Q-Submission (Pre-Submission briefing packages & meetings)
- Small Business Documentation (SBD) fee relief (-75% user fees)
- Official US Agent representation for non-US establishments
- FDA Form 483 inspection responses & Warning Letter remediation
- Medical Device Reporting (MDR) & 21 CFR 803 complaint files
- Quality System Inspection Technique (QSIT) mock inspections

### 4. Global Markets & Quality Systems
- Medical Device Single Audit Program (MDSAP) covering USA, Canada, Brazil, Japan, Australia
- ISO 13485:2016 Quality Management System design, documentation, and audit readiness
- IMDRF & GHTF Standardized Technical Documentation (STED)
- Country registrations: ANVISA (Brazil), TGA (Australia), Health Canada, SFDA (Saudi Arabia), SAHPRA (South Africa)
- Process Validation (IQ, OQ, PQ) per GHTF guidelines
- Biological Evaluation Plans & Reports (BEP/BER) per ISO 10993 with scientific test waiver justifications
